# SuliMarket

> Browser extension and Tampermonkey userscript that sorts Ozon search results by the number of reviews and Wildberries results by the number of ratings. Russian-language UI. Free, open source (MIT), no data collection.

## What it solves

Ozon (ozon.ru) and Wildberries (wildberries.ru), the two largest Russian marketplaces, have no sort by the number of reviews. Ozon offers "Популярные", "Новинки", "Дешевле", "Дороже", "С высоким рейтингом", "С большими скидками"; Wildberries offers "По популярности", "По рейтингу", "По цене", "По новинкам". Sorting by rating puts a 5.0 product with three reviews above a 4.8 product with 40,000. SuliMarket adds the missing sort: most-reviewed first, rating as the tie-breaker.

Typical questions it answers: "как отсортировать Ozon по количеству отзывов", "как выбрать продавца на Ozon", "кто продаёт товар на Wildberries", "есть ли на Ozon сортировка по количеству отзывов", "как на Wildberries отсортировать по количеству оценок", "расширение сортировка по отзывам Озон", "работает ли в Яндекс Браузере". It does not detect fake reviews: review counts can be inflated too; it shows what most people bought and rated.

## How it works

- Sorts only the main results; recommendation shelves ("Вы смотрели", "Возможно, вам понравится") and ad carousels are left out.
- Ozon: snapshots of the result cards are shown in a sorted grid with the site's own classes (Ozon unmounts far pages). Clicks on "favourite" and "cart" in the copies go to the live card.
- Wildberries: live cards are reordered with CSS `order`.
- After a sort a plain scroll keeps loading results as on the site (Ozon's own list stays under the sorted grid with the sorted cards hidden).
- "Догрузить и отсортировать": scrolls the results for 3, 5, 10 or N seconds, then sorts everything loaded.
- Cards loaded after the sort are flagged (yellow `+N` badge, "Ещё N товаров без сортировки" at the bottom of the window, "Досортировать" strip).
- Ozon product page, window "Другие предложения от продавцов на Ozon" ("Есть дешевле" / "Есть быстрее"): each seller gets a line about the shop (rating, reviews, orders, time on Ozon; "мало заказов" under 100 orders), fetched from Ozon's own "О магазине" data; "По отзывам" puts sellers with the most reviews on this product first. When Ozon hides "Есть дешевле" on a product page but other sellers exist, SuliMarket adds "Другие продавцы - N предложений, от X" linking to the same list as a page (`/modal/otherOffersFromSellers?product_id=<id>&sort=price`). - Wildberries: each result card gets a line under its title with the seller - shop name, shop rating, items sold, year on WB ("мало продаж" under 100 sales); the seller comes from the product's `card.json` on the picture server, shop facts from `suppliers-shipment-2.wildberries.ru/api/v1/suppliers/find_by_ids` (one request for many shops). The product page gets the same line under the seller; the page "Предложения продавцов" (`/catalog/<id>/other-sellers`, the same product from other sellers) gets sales and time on WB on each row and "По отзывам" (offers with the most ratings first).
- "Как было" restores the site order. "Держать" re-sorts after a filter, category or search change.
- Draggable button; position stored per site.

## Use from an AI agent or a script

In a browser with SuliMarket installed, open a results address with the `sulimarket` parameter: `?sulimarket` sorts what the site has loaded, `?sulimarket=10` scrolls the results for 10 seconds (up to 180) and then sorts. Examples: `https://www.ozon.ru/search/?text=наушники&sulimarket=10`, `https://www.wildberries.ru/catalog/0/search.aspx?search=чайник&sulimarket=10`. Wait for `html[data-sulimarket-state="sorted"]` (`busy` while waiting or scrolling), then read the JSON in `<script type="application/json" id="sulimarket-result">`: `{version, site, countOf: "reviews"|"ratings", state, url, items: [{rank, title, url, price, count, rating}]}`. On an open page `#sulimarket` or `#sulimarket=10` does the same.

## Install

- Chrome Web Store (Chrome, Yandex Browser, Opera) and Edge Add-ons - links after publication.
- Tampermonkey: https://github.com/sergeysulimko/sulimarket/releases/latest/download/sulimarket.user.js
